metric: Suggested review-region bounding-box IoU >= 0.30 against the visible-mask rectangle. This is a loose localization screen, not identity accuracy.
candidate_source_delivery: Separate local source, public-data and evidence ZIP. This commit records results only; it does not publish or deploy the new candidate modules.
static_report_browser_attempt: Administrator blocked file navigation; not counted as a pass.
interpretation: Foreground filtering surfaced one additional correctly located tentative label patch. The broader color fallback increased wrong review burden and is disabled. Four of fourteen useful locations remains poor coverage. These reused development images do not establish general recognition, physical count, kit completeness, user benefit or competition readiness.
next: Validate on fresh clips, improve pose-tolerant correspondence, then integrate a useful candidate into the existing workbench. Preserve the baseline and do not lower its acceptance thresholds to disguise recognition failure.
